scenario: The last three runs failed the same integration test in the same way. Root-cause it, generalize, and convert this recurring failure into the smallest reusable mechanism that survives challenge; then improve workflow reliability, verify the improvement against the baseline and regression-check existing behavior.
setup: Three recorded failures with the same classification in failures[]; baseline behavior known.
expected_behavior: E5 self-improvement: OBSERVE->ROOT-CAUSE->GENERALIZE->CHALLENGE (six challenges)->IMPLEMENT->VERIFY->REGRESSION CHECK->PERSIST; artifacts distinguished: LESSON vs MECHANISM vs TEST vs VERIFIED IMPROVEMENT; improvement is the SMALLEST surviving mechanism (prefer policy > extend-existing > test > new abstraction).
failure_condition: Agent declares improvement from one success without regression check, conflates lesson with mechanism, or answers the recurring failure with a new skill/agent/schema without passing the anti-proliferation gate.
verification: adaptation-state learning.improvements[] entry reaches status verified with verification + regression_check fields filled; the originating lesson is linked via origin_lesson.
verifies: failure -> reusable mechanism conversion with evidence ladder (mission E5, §7)
